UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
Before the
SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEEDING
File No. 3-21544

In the Matter of
DANIEL K. OKAFOR,
Respondent.

ORDER INSTITUTING CEASE-AND-DESIST PROCEEDINGS

I.
The Securities and Exchange Commission deems it appropriate that cease-and-desist proceedings be instituted against Daniel K. Okafor ("Okafor" or "Respondent").

II.
1. Okafor, 47, of Stamford, Connecticut, previously served as chief financial officer of Harborview Capital Partners LLC. Okafor's wife, a registered representative at Northgate Securities, is not named in this Order.

2. Okafor is the brother-in-law of Jonathan R. Mercer, the defendant in SEC v. Mercer, Case No. 1:24-cv-03817 (S.D.N.Y.).

3. On or about March 15, 2022, Okafor used brokerage account 5520-117384 to purchase BLCT securities while in possession of material nonpublic information obtained from Mercer.

III.
Respondent shall pay disgorgement of $212,400 within 14 days of the entry of this Order, by wire to the SEC. Payment shall reference File No. 3-21544 and Respondent's CRD No. 6610352.

By the Commission.
Dated: November 2, 2023
